Author: jFray
Name: EchoMix
Description: An interactive DJ deck with live mixing tools, custom playlists, and a synced listener mode with an audio visualizer.
Punchline: Spin tracks and let the party sync in.
Changelog:
Shift-drag a deck's fader to push the other deck's fader the opposite way
Shift-drag a knob to audition it - let go and it snaps back to normal
Removed the Deck A/B labels and fixed a few header/settings layout jumps
